run_vr_racecar_simulation: run the pybullet VR racecar differential simulation with GUI and controller input
create_gear_constraints: create gear joint constraints between racecar wheel joints using p.createConstraint with JOINT_GEAR type
control_joint_motors: control racecar wheel and steering joints using p.setJointMotorControl2 with VELOCITY_CONTROL or POSITION_CONTROL
read_vr_events: read VR controller events and convert quaternion orientation to Euler angles for steering input
add_debug_sliders: add user debug parameters for wheel velocity, max force, and steering angle sliders in the GUI
